# Asaki Memory Manager

> A Cloudflare-native, single-operator memory layer for AI agents.

## Overview

The Worker exposes a bearer-authenticated REST API and remote MCP endpoint. D1 stores memories, reviews, and events; Vectorize is a recoverable semantic index; Workers AI provides embeddings and candidate decisions. Claude Code, Pi, and Codex integrations are included. Unsupervised background classifier candidates enter human review rather than being written automatically.

## Source of truth

- `src/index.ts`: API routes and authentication.
- `src/services/`: data and memory behavior.
- `src/utils/validation.ts`: API validation.
- `integrations/`: client implementations.
- `package.json`: install scripts and test/eval commands.
